title: Global sections comparison for a finite ordered flasque Cech total
statement: Let G be a nonnegative cochain complex of O_X-module sheaves, with flasque underlying sheaf in every nonnegative degree [def-sc-zariski-flasque]. For a finite open cover V:Fin r → Opens(X), the canonical global-sections augmentation alpha [def-sc-alternating-cech-total-complex] into the ordered Cech total of G is a quasi-isomorphism. No coefficient augmentation or sectionwise acyclicity assumption is needed. The category of module sheaves is [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

proof.text: For nonnegative coefficient degrees use the flasque row augmentation quasi-isomorphism.
For negative coefficient degrees G is zero, hence injective, so the existing injective row augmentation also supplies the row quasi-isomorphism.

Reuse alternatingCechDouble_isZero_column from Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.InjectiveTermsAlternatingCechAugmentation: columns outside 0,...,r-1 vanish by extension by zero and absence of increasing tuples. Apply the finite-strip row augmentation theorem with the canonical restriction components. The injective-terms comparison theorem itself is not used.
